reviewer_notes: The paper proposes a 'leading EnPI' — a weighted composite index of EnMS (PDCA) implementation status, self-assessed via questionnaires. It explicitly does not measure actual energy consumption/performance, so several C-schema fields (energy vector, denominator, C5 measurement, C8 fit/validation) are meaningless or absent and coded accordingly. The case study at 'Company X' (an integrated oil and gas company including gas treatment, production separation, a refinery/condensate-splitter division, and transportation) reported an overall 94% score toward 'compliance level'; this is the model's headline output but is an implementation-progress score, not an energy result, so it is not recorded under C8.energy_result. Sector coded 'petroleum refining' by inference from the refinery division (Division D); the company is actually integrated upstream/midstream/downstream oil & gas. Estimation is a weighted scoring scheme, not statistical estimation.
